input.rationale: Two-part FRQ-style item. Part (a) needs ceiling division with integer arithmetic and care at exact multiples of 60 and at 0 minutes. Part (b) needs a call to hoursCharged, a two-tier fee (4 dollars for the first 2 hours, 3 dollars after) and a cap at 20 dollars, written with conditionals. The arithmetic is trivial and the reading load is small. The difficulty comes from the boundary and tier logic, which are allowed levers.
